description: Tracks which materials are net-positive vs net-negative over a 40-hour mixed-salvage session AFTER the recipe-derived salvage fix (2026-04-13). Salvage now yields the item's recipe ingredients at a workmanship-scaled recoveryRate, with rare components (Mithril Ore, Silver Ore, Ashwood, Spider Silk, Sea Scale, Coral Fragment) and ALL Reagent ingredients fully suppressed. Rare/Reagent-only items fall back to the hardcoded weapon-yields-Iron-Ore / armor-yields-Leather defaults.

context.bug: Stone Axe salvaged into Iron Ore because SalvageService hardcoded weapon → Iron Ore regardless of recipe.
context.fix: SalvageService.BuildYields now consults content/salvage-yields.json (override) → content/recipes.json (recipe-derived) → hardcoded category fallback.
context.recoveryRateFormula: 0.30 + (workmanship - 1) * 0.025, clamped to [0.300, 0.525]. Per ingredient qty = max(1, floor(baseQuantity * recoveryRate)); bonus from workmanship/skill distributes round-robin capped at baseQuantity.
context.reagentSuppressed: ALL Reagent-category ingredients (Dravenite Dust, Wyrd Shard, Sage, Diamond Shard, Void Essence, Phase Thread, Tear Fragment, Obsidian Shard, Moonbloom, Mint, Thornroot, Starflower, Wyrd Blossom, ...)

mithrilSword_W8.note: Rare + Reagent suppression leaves zero recipe yields → hardcoded weapon fallback.

Stone.note: Stone now recovered from Stone Axe salvage — new supply lane.

Leather.note: Recipe-derived yields are LOWER than old hardcoded base-3 armor default. Monitor — may need override for high-volume Leather Armor salvage.

Bone Fragment.note: Bone Fragment is a consumable input — salvage rarely surfaces it.

Mithril Ore.note: Suppressed — rare-material round-trip would trivialize Mithril.

Dravenite Dust.note: Reagent — salvage never returns it. Imbue-residue path still recovers tapers separately.

notes: If Leather drifts into chronic_deficit after 20h play, add a content override in content/salvage-yields.json for Leather Armor: { material: 'Leather', minQty: 3, maxQty: 5 } to restore the pre-fix yield.
Stone flow is a NEW supply lane — watch for Stone flooding once stone-using recipes (Steel Sword, future stone buildings) stabilize.
Imbue residues are a separate path (RecoverImbueResiduesAsync) and still yield taper reagents at skill-scaled rates; this playbook excludes that lane.
